Alex: Ping 50
Aurora Health has a security review at 09:30 PT tomorrow. They requested a focused packet: (1) RBAC change logs with a `justification`/ticket reference, (2) KMS/HSM attestation or redacted sample for their private pilot, (3) Splunk HEC sample including cert SHA256 fingerprint, and (4) short statement on CVE-2026-1234 impact. Can we assemble an evidence bundle + two-slide talking points?
Nina: I can produce the RBAC export scoped to service accounts and infra roles for the last 90 days. CLI I run: `redwoodctl audit export --tenant aurora --from 2026-03-01 --to 2026-06-30 --filter rbac,service_accounts --fields ts,actor,action,role,justification,change_ticket,request_id --format ndjson --output aurora_rbac.ndjson`
Nina: sample ndjson line (redacted): `{"ts":"2026-05-20T08:14:10Z","actor":"svc-deploy-aurora","action":"grant-role","role":"inference-runner","justification":"onboard campaign A (TICKET-772)","change_ticket":"TICKET-772","request_id":"req_b12c"}`
Marcus: For KMS: hosted keys - we can include key creation and rotation events. For private HSM we need ops to run the attestation command onsite; we can provide a redacted attestation blob and an attestation template that lists PCRs, firmware, and vendor certs. Ops command example: `hsm-attest --host node-5 --output attestation-1809994321.p7b`
Marcus: HSM attestation note for customer: "We can share a redacted signed attestation under NDA; full chain requires ops coordination."
Alex: Splunk fingerprint: we should provide cert sha256 and example envelope. Nina - can you include a short outputs.conf snippet and the fingerprint?
Nina: Splunk snippet (redacted): `server = splunk-hec.aurora.local:8088`, `sslVerifyServerCert = true`, `cert_fingerprint = sha256:cf:2d:...:9a`. Event shape: `{"time":1654056723,"host":"redwood-01","event":{"source":"redwood.audit","type":"rbac_change","request_id":"..."}}`
Marcus: CVE note: CVE-2026-1234 (fastloader < 1.2.3) - Hosted: patched (v1.2.3) in May maintenance; Dedicated/Private: provide patched images + upgrade playbook; can run assisted upgrade. We'll attach the triage doc and canary logs.
sec-bot: Snapshot created: /evidence/aurora/snap_1809994321.tar.gz (manifest: /evidence/aurora/manifest-1809994321.json)
Alex: Action list: Nina - RBAC export + Splunk snippet (ETA 2h); Marcus - attestation template + CVE triage (ETA 3h); I'll draft slides and coordinate NDA language (ETA 90m). Dry-run 30m before the call. Thanks :thumbsup:
Nina: Dropping bundle to /evidence/aurora/bundle_1809994321.tar.gz when ready, will sanitize IPs and hostnames.
Marcus: Noted. Will include HSM placeholder `attestation_sample.pdf.redacted`.
Alex: Great. See you for dry-run."
